about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Sugar Scrolls with Cream Cheese Glaze
recipes.summary: Soft yeasted spirals filled with cinnamon sugar and finished with a tangy cream cheese glaze.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, caster sugar and salt, then stir in the warm milk, melted butter and egg to a soft dough. Knead for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover and prove until doubled.
Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional). Line a 23cm square tin or 12-hole tin with baking paper.
Roll the dough to a 30cm by 40cm rectangle. Spread with the softened butter and sprinkle with the brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll up from the long side and cut into 12 slices.
Place cut side up in the tin, cover and rest until puffy. Bake for 22 to 25 minutes until golden and the base sounds hollow when tapped.
Beat the cream cheese and icing sugar with 1 tbsp warm water until smooth. Spread over the warm scrolls.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving.
Storage: best the day they are baked; keep covered for 2 days and warm for 15 seconds before eating.

recipes.title: Orange Cardamom Knots
recipes.summary: Twisted buns with orange zest and cardamom, glazed with a sugar syrup.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, 70g sugar, salt and half the cardamom. Stir in the warm milk, melted butter, egg and zest, then knead for 8 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove until doubled.
Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional). Line two trays with baking paper.
Roll the dough to a 30cm by 40cm rectangle. Spread with the softened butter and sprinkle with the 40g sugar and remaining cardamom. Fold into thirds and cut into 12 strips.
Twist each strip, tie into a loose knot and place on the trays. Cover and rest until puffy, then brush with the beaten egg.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until deep golden. Dissolve the glaze sugar in 2 tbsp hot water, brush over the buns and cool on a rack.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving.
Storage: keeps 2 days; freezes for 2 months.

recipes.title: Chocolate Babka Buns
recipes.summary: Twisted chocolate swirl buns baked in a muffin tin, with a sugar syrup shine.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, caster sugar and salt. Stir in the warm milk, melted butter and eggs and knead for 8 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove until doubled.
Mix the chocolate, softened butter, cocoa and icing sugar into a thick paste.
Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional). Grease a 12-hole muffin tin.

Roll the dough to a 30cm by 40cm rectangle, spread with the chocolate paste and roll up from the long side. Halve lengthways, twist the two strands together, cut into 12 pieces and press each into the tin.
Cover and rest until puffy. Bake for 22 to 25 minutes until deep golden. Brush with the sugar dissolved in 2 tbsp hot water and cool in the tin for 5 minutes.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving.
Storage: keeps 2 days; best slightly warm.

recipes.title: Mini Brioche Buns
recipes.summary: Rich, golden and buttery little buns, soft enough to eat plain or with jam.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, then add the eggs and warm milk and knead for 10 minutes until smooth and sticky.
Add the butter a piece at a time, kneading until the dough is glossy, smooth and pulls away from the bowl. Cover and prove until doubled.
Heat the oven to 190°C fan (210°C conventional). Divide the dough into 12 pieces, shape into balls and place on lined trays.
Cover and rest until puffy, brush with the beaten egg and bake for 14 to 15 minutes until deep golden and hollow when tapped on the base.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 bun. Plus about 2 hours proving.
Storage: keeps 2 days; freezes for 2 months.

recipes.title: Sweet Brioche Rolls with Honey Butter
recipes.summary: Soft brioche rolls brushed with honey butter while hot.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, add the eggs and warm milk and knead for 10 minutes until smooth.
Add the softened butter a piece at a time, kneading until the dough is glossy and elastic. Cover and prove until doubled.
Heat the oven to 190°C fan (210°C conventional). Divide into 12 pieces, shape into balls and place close together in a lined 23cm by 33cm tin.
Cover and rest until puffy, then bake for 16 to 18 minutes until deep golden and hollow when tapped.
Stir the melted butter and honey together and brush over the hot rolls.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus about 2 hours proving.
Storage: keeps 2 days in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Pull-Apart Bread
recipes.summary: Sweet dough balls tossed in cinnamon sugar around cooked apple, baked in a loaf tin and torn apart.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, caster sugar and salt, add the warm milk, 50g butter and egg and knead for 8 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove until doubled.
Cook the apples in the 1 tbsp butter for 5 minutes until just soft, then cool.
Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional). Line a 23cm loaf tin with baking paper.
Divide the dough into 24 pieces. Roll each in the 60g melted butter, then in the brown sugar and cinnamon mixed together. Layer in the tin with the apples scattered between.
Cover and rest until puffy, then bake for 28 to 30 minutes until deep golden. Cool for 10 minutes before pulling apart and serving in 12 portions.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving.
Storage: best warm on the day; keeps 2 days.

recipes.title: Sticky Honey Buns
recipes.summary: Soft buns baked in a honey and butter syrup so the bases come out glossy and sticky.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, caster sugar and salt, add the warm milk, melted butter and egg and knead for 8 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove until doubled.
Melt the 80g butter, honey and brown sugar together, stirring for 3 minutes until smooth and bubbling, then pour into a lined 23cm by 33cm tin and scatter with the pecans.
Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional). Divide the dough into 12 pieces, shape into balls and place on the syrup. Cover and rest until puffy.
Bake for 25 to 28 minutes until deep golden. Cool for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a board with the syrup side up.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains nuts. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving.
Storage: best the day they are baked; keep covered for 2 days.

recipes.title: Finnish Pulla Braid Slices
recipes.summary: A cardamom-scented braided loaf with pearl-free simplicity, sliced for coffee time.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt and cardamom, add the warm milk, melted butter and egg and knead for 10 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove until doubled.
Divide the dough into three, roll each into a 40cm rope and braid. Place on a lined tray, cover and rest until puffy.
Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional).
Brush with the beaten egg, scatter with the almonds and bake for 28 to 30 minutes until deep golden and hollow when tapped.
Cool on a rack and cut into 12 slices.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains nuts. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving.
Storage: keeps 3 days wrapped; freezes well in slices.

recipes.title: Swedish Saffron Buns
recipes.summary: Golden saffron buns shaped as S curls, traditionally made for winter celebrations.
steps: Soak the saffron in the warm water. Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, add the milk, melted butter, egg and saffron water and knead for 8 minutes until smooth and golden. Cover and prove until doubled.
Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional). Line two trays with baking paper.
Divide the dough into 12 pieces, roll each into a 25cm rope and coil the ends in opposite directions into an S shape. Press a sultana into each coil.
Cover and rest until puffy, brush with the beaten egg and bake for 12 to 15 minutes until golden.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving.
Storage: keeps 2 days; freezes for 2 months.

recipes.title: Challah Rolls with Honey
recipes.summary: Plaited-style egg bread rolls with a honey glaze and no dairy.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, add the eggs, oil and warm water and knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and prove until doubled.
Divide the dough into 12 pieces. Roll each into a rope, loop into a loose knot and place on lined trays.
Cover and rest until puffy. Heat the oven to 190°C fan (210°C conventional).
Brush with the beaten egg and bake for 18 to 20 minutes until deep golden and hollow when tapped.
Warm the honey with 1 tbsp water, brush over the hot rolls and cool on a rack.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Dairy free. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving.
Storage: keeps 2 days; freezes for 2 months.

recipes.title: Glazed Yeast Doughnuts
recipes.summary: Light, airy ring doughnuts fried until golden and dipped in a vanilla glaze.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, add the warm milk, butter and egg and knead for 8 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove until doubled.
Roll to 1.5cm thick, cut 12 rings with a 8cm and a 3cm cutter and rest on baking paper until puffy.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 175°C. Fry 3 doughnuts at a time for 1 minute each side until golden, turning once, and drain on paper towel.
Whisk the icing sugar, vanilla and 3 tbsp warm water into a glaze.
Dip the warm doughnuts in the glaze and set on a rack.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving. Never leave hot oil unattended and keep the lid of the pan nearby.
Storage: best the day they are made.

recipes.title: Apple Cider Doughnut Holes
recipes.summary: Fried cake doughnut bites with apple juice and cinnamon, tossed in sugar.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, 1 tsp cinnamon, nutmeg and brown sugar. Whisk the egg, apple juice and butter, then stir in until a soft thick batter forms.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 175°C.
Drop heaped tablespoons of batter into the oil, 5 at a time, and fry for 2 to 3 minutes, turning, until deep golden and cooked through.
Drain on paper towel. Toss the warm holes in the caster sugar and remaining cinnamon.
Serve warm, 3 or 4 to a portion.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: about 3 holes. Never leave hot oil unattended.
Storage: best within a few hours of frying.

recipes.title: Apple Fritters
recipes.summary: Chunks of apple in a light batter, fried until crisp and rolled in cinnamon sugar.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder and 1 tbsp sugar. Whisk in the egg and milk to a thick batter, then fold in the apples.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 170°C.
Drop heaped tablespoons of batter into the oil, 4 at a time, and fry for 3 minutes, turning once, until deep golden and the apple is soft.
Drain on paper towel and roll in the remaining sugar mixed with the cinnamon.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 fritters. Never leave hot oil unattended.
Storage: best the day they are made.

recipes.title: Pineapple Fritters
recipes.summary: Rings of pineapple in a light batter, fried until crisp and dusted with sugar.

items: 8 tinned pineapple rings, drained and patted dry

steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder and caster sugar. Whisk in the egg and milk until smooth.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 175°C.
Dip the pineapple rings in the batter, let the excess drip off and fry 3 at a time for 2 minutes, turning once, until deep golden.
Drain on paper towel, dust with the icing sugar and serve warm.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 fritter. Never leave hot oil unattended.
Storage: best eaten straight away.

recipes.title: Sweet Corn Fritters with Maple
recipes.summary: Sweet corn fritters pan-fried until crisp, served with maple syrup.
steps: Mix the corn, flour, baking powder, eggs, milk, spring onions and salt into a thick batter.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Cook 3 heaped tablespoons of batter at a time for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through, making 12 fritters.
Drain on paper towel and serve with the maple syrup.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 3 fritters.
Storage: keeps 1 day in the fridge; reheat in a hot oven for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Ricotta Doughnut Puffs
recipes.summary: Light fried puffs made with ricotta and lemon zest, rolled in sugar.
steps: Beat the ricotta, eggs, 2 tbsp sugar and lemon zest until smooth, then stir in the flour and baking powder.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 170°C.
Drop heaped teaspoons of the mixture into the oil, 6 at a time, and fry for 3 minutes, turning, until deep golden and puffed.
Drain on paper towel and roll in the 40g sugar.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: about 4 puffs. Never leave hot oil unattended.
Storage: best eaten warm on the day.

recipes.title: Sufganiyot
recipes.summary: Round yeast doughnuts filled with apricot jam and dusted with icing sugar, made for Hanukkah.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, add the yolks, warm milk and butter and knead for 8 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove until doubled.
Roll to 1.5cm thick, cut 12 rounds with a 7cm cutter and rest on baking paper until puffy.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 175°C. Fry 3 at a time for 1 minute each side until golden, then drain on paper towel.
Cool slightly, then use a piping bag to fill each with about 1 tbsp of jam through a small hole and dust with the icing sugar.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving. Never leave hot oil unattended.
Storage: best the day they are made.

recipes.title: Beignets
recipes.summary: Square pillowy yeast doughnuts, fried and buried in icing sugar.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, add the egg, warm milk and butter and knead for 8 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove until doubled.
Roll to 8mm thick and cut into 24 squares about 5cm wide. Rest on baking paper until puffy.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 175°C. Fry 4 at a time for 1 minute each side until puffed and golden.
Drain on paper towel and dust generously with the icing sugar.
Serve straight away, 2 to a portion.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving. Never leave hot oil unattended.
Storage: best eaten within an hour of frying.

recipes.title: Zeppole
recipes.summary: Choux dough puffs fried until crisp and golden, dusted with icing sugar.
steps: Heat the butter, water, sugar and salt in a pan until the butter melts and the mixture boils. Tip in the flour all at once and stir for 2 minutes until it forms a smooth ball that leaves the pan.
Cool for 5 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time until glossy, and stir in the lemon zest.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 170°C. Using two spoons, drop tablespoons of the dough into the oil, 5 at a time, and fry for 5 minutes, turning, until deep golden and puffed.
Drain on paper towel and dust with the icing sugar.
Serve warm, 3 to a portion.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Never leave hot oil unattended.
Storage: best eaten warm on the day.

recipes.title: Fruit Loaf Slices
recipes.summary: A soft spiced yeast loaf studded with sultanas and raisins, best toasted with butter.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt and spices, add the warm milk, melted butter and egg and knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Knead in the sultanas and raisins, cover and prove until doubled.
Shape into a loaf and place in a lined 23cm loaf tin. Cover and rest until it rises just above the tin.
Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional). Bake for 32 to 35 minutes until deep golden and hollow when tapped on the base.
Cool on a rack and slice into 12.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving.
Storage: keeps 4 days wrapped; freezes well sliced.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Dinner Rolls
recipes.summary: Soft, golden rolls made with mashed sweet potato for moisture and a mild natural sweetness.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, add the mashed sweet potato, warm milk, butter and egg and knead for 8 minutes until smooth and slightly tacky. Cover and prove until doubled.
Divide the dough into 12 pieces, shape into balls and place in a lined 23cm square tin. Cover and rest until puffy.
Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional). Brush with the milk and bake for 20 to 22 minutes until deep golden and hollow when tapped.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then on a rack.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus about 1 hour 30 minutes proving.
Storage: keeps 3 days in a sealed bag; freezes for 2 months.
